reason: On billpay.send-on-date-picker, Tab from the Recipient gets field reaches the Send on textbox on the second stop (Send from, then Send on). The sweep's xpath points at the pre-click field, which the calendar replaces with a new input one div shallower; the sweep's own trace focuses that input at stop 4. In the parent state billpay.pay-amount, Tab focuses the field and opens the calendar on focus.
